pictures.name: OC1-Lost-In-Forest
pictures.prompt: A deep, ancient Indian forest of huge trees and hanging vines, shafts of gold light falling through mist. In the middle, a traveler (a lean ancient Indian man of about thirty, short beard, a simple indigo cotton wrap and turban, a walking staff) pauses, uncertain, looking around for a way through. Deep green and blue shadows, gold light.
